name: Hooded travelling cloak
description: Waxed against the weather, with a hood deep enough to hide in or sulk in.
notes: Clothes: a heavier hooded cloak, at the top of the cloth weight range. Weight 2.5 kg (ADR-0003 reference weights). Catalogue tier common (economy doc, clothes 20-80). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
